tei:div.tei:p: smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyud bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru bhya/ smad 'dul du grags pa'i bshad rgyud ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas te/ nye bar 'khor/ kun dga' bo dang*/ sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas dhi dhi ka nag po legs mthong*/ blo gros mi 'bebs/ yon tan 'od/ shā kya 'od/ chos kyi bshes gnyen/ che chung gnyis/ de gnyis kas seng ge gdong can/ des dha na shī la dang*/ dzī na mi tra/ des lcog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ des g.yo dge 'byung dang*/ gtsang rab gsal/ dmar shā kya mu ne gsum la bshad/ de gsum mdo smad du byon nas/ a mes bla chen dgong pa rab gsal la bshad/ des slob ma la snga ba khams kyi zog po mi drug bya ba byung te/ spang gong ye shes g.yung drung*/ par rin chen gsal/ 'al rdo rje dbang phyug snubs rakshi ta/ jo bo ye shes seng ge lcog ro shes rab byang chub rnams yin pa/ dang po mkhan slob cha ma tshang bas/ bsnyen rdzogs ma grub/ dge tshul yin/ 'dul ba la sogs chos rnams ni gnang*/ bla chen gyi bon po'i thugs zhen du byas nas/ zhwa theb kyi mu thugs sngon por byed pa sogs kyi/ bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi bya ba yang khong drug po la gnang bar byed do/ /spang par gnyis kyi slob ma/ grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des grum g.yung drung rgyal mtshan shing lag can la/ des dbus gtsang gi mi bcu'i nang nas/ klu mes tshul khrims shes rab la 'dul ba bshad/ des gzus rdo rje rgyal mtshan la/ de nas rim pa bzhin du/ snel bo grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rgya dbang rdor/ bya brtson 'grus 'bar/ rtsis pa gzhon seng*/ snyer chung bzang ston/ de la shā kya'i dge slong thub pa shes rab bdag gi 'dul ba'i chos skor rnams tshang mar zhus pa legs so/ /yang grum shing lag can gyis/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug dang*/ tshong btsun shes rab seng ge sum pa ye shes blo gros/ a btsun shā kya rgyal mtshan/ 'bre ston tshul khrims gzhon nu rnams la/ 'dul ba bshad nas dbus gtsang du dar bar mdzad pa rnams la'ang*/

smad 'dul zer cing*/ bshad rgyud rang rang na gsal lo/ /smad 'dul bshad rgyud 'di bris dge ba yis/ /'dul khrims gtsang zhing 'chad nyan dar bar shog / dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/smad 'dul gyi bshad rgyud/ -PAGE 248--PAGE 267--PAGE 247-
